name: program-cue
description: Conference programme operations platform built as a React Router and Cloudflare Workers modular monolith.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.dev:e2e: node scripts/reset-e2e-state.mjs && npm run db:migrate:e2e && react-router dev --mode e2e
scripts.serve:e2e: node scripts/reset-e2e-state.mjs && npm run db:migrate:e2e && npm run build && wrangler dev build/server/index.js -c wrangler.demo.jsonc --assets build/client --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --log-level warn
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && python3 scripts/validate-migration.py && npm run openapi:check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:core: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && python3 scripts/validate-migration.py && npm run openapi:check
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:check && npm run build && wrangler deploy -c build/server/wrangler.json
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply program-cue-db --local -c wrangler.demo.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply program-cue-db --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state -c wrangler.demo.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply program-cue-db --remote -c wrangler.jsonc
